A fully hand-crafted 3D animated short film where every frame feels like a painting stepped off the page. Born from a year of collaboration between 21+ artists at SCAD, it's a love letter to the drawn line — rendered in three dimensions, coming to festivals summer 2026.

Behind the Scenes

A peek into the world-building, craft, and chaos of making Me in a Nutshell

Making a fully animated short film in a year is no small feat. Here's a look at the process, pipeline, and the people who brought this painted world to life.

Production Timeline

Pre-Production · Spring 2025

Concept & Story Development

The team developed the story, script, and visual language. Mood boards, storyboards, and early style tests formed the foundation.

Pre-Production · Summer 2025

Design & Asset Build

Character design, environment art, and color scripts were locked. Modelers and riggers began building everything from scratch.

Production · Fall 2025

Animation & Scene Build

Animators and layout artists assembled scenes, refining the pipeline to preserve the hand-painted aesthetic through the entire 3D workflow.

Production · Winter 2025–2026

Rendering & FX

Final renders, VFX, and simulation passes brought the world to full life with rich, painterly lighting.

Post-Production · Spring 2026

Compositing, Sound & Delivery

Compositing, color grading, sound design, and music layered in for the SCAD capstone screening and festival submissions.
